shared_elements: standing human figures shown in profile
figures facing one another in a confrontation/offering scene
figure holding a small object in an outstretched hand
long garment with patterned or textured surface
bearded/wigged head in profile with eye shown frontally
low-relief figures aligned on a common ground line
small stand or vessel-like object between figures
justification: Both show profile standing human figures on a ground line confronting one another, one extending a small held object toward another who raises a hand in gesture, with an object/stand between them and long patterned garments acarved in shallow relief. The biggest differences are that B is a compact two-figure panel dominated by dense registers of sign-writing and a tall staff/scepter, whereas A is an extended frieze of several attendants with bucket-like and other implements and no visible script, and A's bodies are more modelled and muscular against B's flatter, more schematic figures.
